summary: Bail denial in UAPA prosecution; offences under IPC 121, 121A, 122 and UAPA 13, 18, 18A, 20; appellant owner of Ahmad Palace where PFI activities occurred; CCTV evidence shows tampering pre-raid; recovery of anti-India documents; rent agreement allegedly fabricated; financial trail to appellant's son; protected witness testimony on extremist meetings; Section 43D(5) UAPA standard applied; sufficient prima facie case established for denial of bail; dismissal of bail appeal upheld.
final_judgment: Bail appeal dismissed; High Court's order refusing bail upheld; appellant to remain in custody during trial.
